Bo•Co Home creates beautiful, Himalayan salt lamps to match decor in every room of your home. Salt lamps are great for your living space, a nursery, child’s room, your pet's favorite area, and especially helpful for someone with breathing issues, depression or anxiety. Also perfect for computer work spaces. negative ions neutralize EMFs and the hot massage ball helps relieve sore muscles. 

Salt attracts moisture to its surface. When salt is heated, moisture evaporates, releasing negative ions into the air. Negative ions are the reason the air is so fresh after a thunderstorm and why we feel relaxed and rejuvenated at the beach.

Positive ions (EMFs, dust, mold, viruses, bacteria, odors, dander, pollen, chemicals) abound indoors and contribute to fatigue, anxiety and depression. Himalayan Salt lamps release negative ions into the air about 4 ft around the lamp’s surface, neutralizing positive ions in that space. For consistent air purification, leave your salt lamp on all the time.

Himalayan salt rocks require no maintenance, other than replacing the bulb (about every 4 months). When your bulb goes out, carefully remove the salt chunks, change the bulb and return the salt chunks to the container.

We offer replacement bulbs here on this site. You can also purchase replacement bulbs (25 Watt, incandescent, candelabra base) on Amazon.

Massage Balls - When you hold a hot Himalayan salt ball, the negative ions have a calming effect on your nervous system.

Negative ions are also anti-inflammatory and users report relieffrom arthritis, sore and tight muscles, and other aches and pains wherever they choose to use the massage ball.
